title: Flexi-Grow: AI-Enabled Soft Robot for Exploration
summary: A pneumatically driven soft-growing robotic platform designed to navigate fragile or narrow environments where traditional rigid robots fail. It utilizes AI-based object detection and real-time FPV video for disaster response and exploration.

title: Dynamic Symmetry-Based Omnidirectional Robot
summary: A versatile robotic system featuring an extreme dynamic symmetry-based mechanical design for flexible, omnidirectional movement and multifunctional applications.
description: The robot features an extreme dynamic symmetry-based mechanical design for omnidirectional movement. Its symmetrical structure enables versatile locomotion in multiple directions.

The mechanism allows the robot to adapt its movement to different terrain conditions and navigation challenges. Its design supports multifunctional applications through flexible and efficient mobility.
The robot demonstrates the potential of symmetrical mechanisms in developing versatile robotic systems.

title: Lunar Rover for NASA's Human Exploration Rover Challenge
summary: A six-wheeled, remote-operated lunar rover I designed and piloted for NASA's Human Exploration Rover Challenge, finishing in the Top 10 of 75 global teams. Inspired by UIU's award-winning Mars rovers, it combines rocker-style suspension, spring-damped wheels and corner steering to cross boulders, ruts and crevasses on a simulated planetary course.

title: Cheap & Rapid Water Contamination Detection System
summary: An ultra-low-cost, handheld device that uses a macro camera and edge AI to inspect water samples. It provides real-time detection of microplastics, microfibers, and iron particles with ~90% accuracy.

title: Autonomous Underwater Robot for Environmental Analysis
summary: This custom AUV submerges to navigate and explore various underwater environments. It inspects water quality in real-time using sensors while detecting contaminants via computer vision. All gathered environmental and visual data is then transmitted back to the surface for analysis.

title: AI-Assisted Drainage & Sewage Maintenance System
summary: A system of specialized robots utilizing AI and computer vision to autonomously detect blockages, identify toxic gases, and clean urban drainage systems. It performs these tasks without risking human lives in hazardous environments.

title: MonAndo: A Mental Wellness App
summary: A free, AI-powered web app that turns ordinary smartphones into Virtual Reality Exposure Therapy (VRET) devices. Designed for underprivileged youth, it provides immersive therapy scenarios, non-judgmental AI reflection, and emergency SOS tools.

title: 6-Wheeler Robot for Pipeline Inspection
summary: A rugged, 6-wheel drive robot that autonomously navigates underground sewage lines to identify blockages and detect explosive gases like methane. It features a robotic arm for debris removal and automatic chemical mitigation.

title: Artificial Soil: Enhanced Substrate for Agriculture
summary: An ultra-lightweight, biologically enhanced coco peat substrate designed to replace traditional soil for rooftop and urban farming. It features superior aeration, retains up to 10x its weight in water, and utilizes Trichoderma fungi for disease resistance.
